reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "helm: configurable API version for PodLog CRD (#10812) (d1dee91)", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: none

consequence.statement: A new Helm configuration option is available to customize the API version of the PodLog CRD; environments that do not use this option are unaffected

proposed.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds a new Helm value to make the API version of the PodLog CRD configurable.
